description: Answers "what do I do here today": for one place and one wallet (or a named crew), today's list of work in order, in blocks of 30 minutes, within the hours the person says they have. It is compiled from what already exists: the place's Standing and which of its conditions are due to be measured again by their own cadence, the open claimable packets at that place, and any packet the wallet already holds and has not proven. A due condition's measurement packet comes first, then what the wallet holds, then the rest by size. A due condition with no packet to serve it is named as a gap, never invented, and a place with nothing open gets an honest empty card. Free, keyless, read-only. IT ORDERS EXISTING WORK AND NEVER POSTS, ASSIGNS OR PAYS: it schedules no one, a packet is never split, and the person still reads the hour card and claims for themselves. Sizes are the top of each packet's own stated time, or an assumed hour where it states none; no travel is counted. A crew card splits whole packets across the named members by hours and is a suggestion the manager may change.

crew.description: Optional managed crew as a comma list of member handles, each optionally with its own hours, e.g. "amina:6,joseph:4". Handles are lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

hours.description: Hours the person has today, from 0.5 to 16. Defaults to 8.

place.description: The place: an address or venue as the board spells it, a place id, or "lat,lng" for the 0.35 km cluster around a point.

wallet.description: The 0x address the card is for (the manager, for a crew). Address only, never a private key.

name: day_card
title: Today's timed list for one place and one person
